values.meaning: Bindings in the loaded Sway configuration, with the owned override applied to editable rows.

bindings.meaning: The default and effective shortcut rows.

name.meaning: Label from the preceding name comment, or an empty string.

command.meaning: The command from the default binding.

overridden.meaning: Whether an owned override supplies the effective keys.

editable.meaning: Whether the binding is an eligible top-level keyboard bindsym.

mode.meaning: The enclosing Sway mode, or null at top level.

include_present.meaning: Whether the override is referenced from the loaded configuration.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Present on refusal. Besides the fixed messages, observation can return missing envelope kernel keys: <comma-separated keys> or raw ValueError, OSError or TypeError diagnostics.
